title: PathNet path with Mirror module-role views
hypothesis: On tasks formed by selecting one module per PathNet layer and applying a two-angle role transformation, a shared 2x2 module bank plus path IDs and two adapted Mirror angles will improve held-out query RMSE by at least 20% over PathNet path-only while staying within 1.25x its actual bytes and no more than 1.25x rank-2 adapter adaptation time; a direct Givens control tests attribution.
physical_object: two physical four-weight linear modules in each of two PathNet layers (four modules total)
mirror_coordinate: two per-task angles, support-adapted after the PathNet route selects one module from each layer
logical_multiplicity: eight task functions from four module paths, each with two role orientations
controls: PathNet path-only with one route per task and no role adaptation (mandatory)
shared module path plus two-angle Mirror view
same shared path plus rank-2 additive residual per route

task.type: four-dimensional linear regression; teacher has two modules in each of two layers and each task target rotates their selected module-sum by two angles; noise sigma=0.02

development.selection_metric: mean query RMSE over the same eight path-role tasks

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: Mirror query RMSE <=0.80x PathNet path-only, actual bytes <=1.25x PathNet path-only and <= independent task-vector payload, end-to-end time <=1.25x rank-2, and native Givens outputs/bytes differ from Mirror.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a success gate or direct native Givens control matches Mirror functions and serialized payload, or path-only equals/beats Mirror within 5% RMSE at lower/equal bytes.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent least-squares query RMSE exceeds 0.08 in both seeds, or serialized output replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic aligned mechanism screen, not a PathNet reproduction, natural multitask benchmark, or neural-network capacity claim.
PathNet path-only is mandatory and reports route indices as paid inference bytes.
A direct native Givens parameterization is a strong simple control and exact alias check.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless both development seeds pass all success gates.
